The synthesised trailing week carries no courier, because nobody rode it; only the seeded working set and deliveries driven in this browser appear here.
platformAnalytics.deliveryNote: The counts cover every delivery order in the range. The times and the on-time rate cover only orders whose timeline was recorded as it happened: the synthesised trailing week reconstructs its timestamps by dividing placement-to-estimate evenly, so including it would report every order as delivered exactly on estimate.

That is a narrower set than the revenue above: the synthesised trailing week names each of its orders from a fixed pool of eight demo contacts, and counting it would report those eight as the platform's customer base. The restaurants, couriers and money above are counted for real.
